decisive_items: homogeneously low in signal on T2-weighted images
demonstrated a thin rim of enhancement with no internal enhancement
response.rationale: Meningioma classically shows T2 hypointensity and thin dural-based enhancement; schwannoma/neurofibroma typically T2 hyperintense with heterogeneous enhancement.

rejected.why: Neurofibroma usually T2 hyperintense and heterogeneous enhancement, not matching low T2 signal.
Schwannoma typically T2 hyperintense and heterogeneous enhancement, less consistent than meningioma.
